tools.name: list_candidates
tools.title: List candidates
tools.description: List candidates in the active tenant. Optional filters: substring search on name, agencyId, pipeline status, availability status. Returns id, name, email, agency, status, and (if scored) overallScore. Pagination via limit (max 200) and offset.

tools.name: get_candidate
tools.title: Get candidate
tools.description: Fetch a single candidate by id with their CV text, agency, contact details, rates, and availability. Returns null if the candidate does not exist or belongs to another tenant.

tools.name: find_candidate_by_email
tools.title: Find candidate by email
tools.description: Look up a candidate by their email address (case-insensitive). Returns the candidate record or null. Useful when an external system references a person by email.

tools.name: update_candidate_status
tools.title: Update candidate pipeline status
tools.description: Move a candidate to a new pipeline stage (new / shortlisted / interviewing / offered / hired / rejected / rejected_by_customer). Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: update_candidate_availability
tools.title: Update candidate availability
tools.description: Set a candidate's availability flag (available / on_project / unavailable) and an optional availableFrom date. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: find_candidate_by_name
tools.title: Find candidate by name
tools.description: Case-insensitive substring match against `firstName + " " + lastName`. Returns up to 20 matches with their agency. Useful when the LLM has only a free-text name.

tools.name: semantic_search_candidates
tools.title: Semantic candidate search
tools.description: Vector-similarity search for candidates against a role's description using pgvector cosine distance. Provide `roleId` (the action embeds the role text). Already-scored candidates on the role are excluded. NOTE v1: free-text `query` is accepted by the schema but returns a clear error — the underlying matching action only supports roleId-based search at present.

tools.name: create_candidate
tools.title: Create candidate from CV
tools.description: Create a new candidate by uploading a CV (base64-encoded). The CV is validated, parsed, stored, and a pending score row is queued against the supplied roleId. Embedding generation runs in the background. Max 10MB per file. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: archive_candidate
tools.title: Archive candidate
tools.description: Soft-archive a candidate (sets isActive = false). The candidate remains queryable for audit/history. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List job roles in the active tenant with their customer, location, deadlines, and budget. By default hides archived roles (set activeOnly=false to include them).

tools.name: get_role
tools.title: Get role
tools.description: Fetch a single role by id with description, requirements, key skills, top requirements, language requirements, and budget. Returns null if not found.

tools.name: get_role_with_candidates
tools.title: Get role with ranked candidates
tools.description: Fetch a role and the candidates scored against it, sorted by overallScore descending. Includes per-dimension scores. Optional minScore filter.

tools.name: update_role
tools.title: Update role
tools.description: Edit an existing role. The server action does a full replace of the editable fields — title/description/requirements are always required. Optional fields default to null/empty when omitted. Tag regeneration runs after the response. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: regenerate_role_tags
tools.title: Regenerate role tags
tools.description: Re-run AI tag extraction (key skills + top requirements) for a role using its current description and requirements. Runs in the background after the response. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: archive_role
tools.title: Archive role
tools.description: Soft-archive a role (isActive=false). Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: list_agencies
tools.title: List agencies
tools.description: List recruitment agencies in the active tenant. The internal-employee bench is exposed as the system "Internal" agency (isInternal=true). Hides archived rows by default.

tools.name: get_agency
tools.title: Get agency
tools.description: Fetch a single agency by id with its contact details and notes.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customer entities (the companies we hire for). Archived rows hidden by default.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by id with portal URL, contact details, and active status.

tools.name: get_candidate_score
tools.title: Get candidate score
tools.description: Fetch the score row for a candidate against a specific role, including all four dimension scores (technical, experience, cultural fit, communication), AI reasoning per dimension, and the AI summary. Returns null if no scoring run exists yet.

tools.name: rescore_candidate
tools.title: Rescore candidate against role
tools.description: Re-run AI scoring for a candidate against a role. The score is reset to pending and the AI pipeline runs in the background. Poll get_candidate_score for results. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: list_interview_packs
tools.title: List interview packs
tools.description: List interview packs in the active tenant. Filter by candidateId and/or roleId. Includes generation status (pending/processing/complete/failed), packType, language, and recommended duration.

tools.name: generate_interview_pack
tools.title: Generate interview pack
tools.description: Queue an interview pack generation job for a candidate × role pair. The pack is created with status="pending" — actual AI generation runs in the background; the LLM should poll get_interview_pack to fetch the questions once status="complete". Pre-screening packs are short, full_technical packs are longer and may include a code challenge. Recruiter/admin only. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: get_interview_pack
tools.title: Get interview pack
tools.description: Fetch a full interview pack (the pack record plus all generated questions). Returns { pack: null, questions: [] } if the pack id is not found in the active tenant.

tools.name: get_approvals_for_role
tools.title: Get approvals for role
tools.description: Fetch the approval state for every shortlisted candidate × assigned manager combination on a role. Returns approval status (pending/approved/rejected), decided-at timestamps, and comments. Used by recruiters to track shortlist progress.

tools.name: approve_candidate
tools.title: Approve candidate (hiring manager)
tools.description: Record a manager approval for a candidate on a role. Only assigned managers (or admins) may decide. Optional comment. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: send_shortlist_for_approval
tools.title: Send shortlist for approval
tools.description: Mark a role's shortlist as sent to its assigned hiring managers and seed pending approval rows for every (shortlisted candidate × manager) pair. Idempotent — re-sending does not reset existing decisions. Recruiter/admin only. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: approve_all_remaining
tools.title: Approve all remaining candidates (hiring manager)
tools.description: Bulk-approve every still-pending approval row owned by the calling manager on the role. Manager scope (the calling user must be assigned as a manager on the role). Optional comment is applied to every row. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: reject_candidate
tools.title: Reject candidate (hiring manager)
tools.description: Record a manager rejection for a candidate on a role. Only assigned managers (or admins) may decide. Optional comment. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: get_my_assigned_roles
tools.title: Get my assigned roles (hiring manager)
tools.description: For the calling hiring manager, list every role that has been assigned to them with pending and decided counts. Returns an empty list if the caller is not a manager.

tools.name: get_role_managers
tools.title: Get role managers
tools.description: List the hiring managers currently assigned to a role, with email, name, primary flag, and added-at timestamp. Returns [] if no managers are assigned (or role does not exist).

tools.name: assign_role_managers
tools.title: Assign role managers
tools.description: Replace the full set of hiring managers for a role with the supplied userIds. Non-hiring_manager users are silently dropped. If primaryUserId is supplied AND is in the valid set it is flagged as primary. Recruiter/admin only. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: remove_role_manager
tools.title: Remove role manager
tools.description: Detach a single hiring manager from a role. Recruiter/admin only. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: create_note
tools.title: Create candidate note
tools.description: Add a timestamped note to a candidate. Body is plain text up to 5000 chars. The note is attributed to the calling user. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: update_note
tools.title: Update candidate note
tools.description: Edit the body of an existing note. Only the original author or an admin may edit. Sets isEdited=true. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.title: Delete candidate note
tools.description: Permanently delete a note. Only the original author or an admin may delete. Requires write scope and confirmed: true.

tools.name: list_users
tools.title: List tenant users
tools.description: List all users in the active tenant. Admin scope required.

tools.name: update_user_role
tools.title: Update user role
tools.description: Change a user's product-role (admin / recruiter / hiring_manager / viewer). You cannot change your own role. Admin scope required, confirmed: true required.

tools.name: invite_user
tools.title: Invite user
tools.description: Create a single-use invitation for a new user in the active tenant. Returns the invitation id, raw token, and a fully-qualified invite URL the admin can share. The role can be any of admin/recruiter/hiring_manager/viewer. Note: createInvitation server action reads its tenant from HTTP headers, so we mirror its (small) logic here against withTenant — same pattern used by update_user_role and deactivate_user. Admin scope and confirmed: true required.

tools.name: deactivate_user
tools.title: Deactivate user
tools.description: Soft-deactivate a user (sets isActive=false). You cannot deactivate yourself. Admin scope and confirmed: true required.

tools.name: list_configured_keys
tools.title: List configured API keys
tools.description: List which AI provider keys (anthropic / google / openai) are configured for the active tenant. Returns just the key NAMES, never the secret values. Admin scope required.

tools.name: export_candidate_cv_pdf
tools.title: Export candidate CV (raw file)
tools.description: Return the candidate's stored CV file as a base64 attachment. The file is whatever format was uploaded (PDF/DOCX/ODT/RTF/TXT/MD) — not necessarily PDF. Returns null attachment if the candidate has no stored file.

tools.name: export_candidate_internal_pdf
tools.title: Export candidate profile PDF (internal)
tools.description: Render the full internal candidate profile PDF — includes scores, agency, rates, recruiter notes, transcript red flags, and recommended decision. If roleId is supplied the PDF's "active role" section uses that role's score; otherwise the most recent complete score is used.

tools.name: export_candidate_customer_pdf
tools.title: Export candidate profile PDF (customer-safe)
tools.description: Render the customer-facing candidate profile PDF — strips recruiter notes, candidate rate, margin, red flags, recommended decision, and blanks low-confidence transcript reasoning. Safe to forward outside the company.

tools.name: export_role_brief_pdf
tools.title: Export role brief PDF
tools.description: Render a one-role-brief PDF with title, customer, location, work mode, language requirements, key skills, top requirements, budget, and the full description + requirements.

tools.name: export_shortlist_pdf
tools.title: Export shortlist PDF
tools.description: Render the ranked shortlist for a role as a single PDF. audience="recruiter" includes agency + margin per candidate; audience="customer" suppresses the margin column.

tools.name: export_interview_pack_pdf
tools.title: Export interview pack PDF
tools.description: Render a fully-generated interview pack (questions + optional code challenge) as a PDF. Returns null attachment if the pack does not exist or has not finished generating (generationStatus must be "complete").

tools.name: compose_candidate_email_attachments
tools.title: Compose candidate email attachments
tools.description: Killer-workflow tool. Returns everything an LLM needs to draft an email about a candidate-on-a-role in a single call: { candidate, role, attachments: { cv, interviewPack?, scoreSummary } }. Sub-fetches: (1) the raw CV file from disk, (2) the most recent interview pack for this candidate × role pair (omitted if none exists or the latest is not yet complete), (3) the structured score record (overall, dimensions, reasoning, summary). Read-only; no confirm.

resources.name: candidate
resources.description: A single candidate record with their agency name and contact details.

resources.name: role
resources.description: A role record together with all candidates scored against it, sorted by overallScore.

resources.name: interview-pack
resources.description: An interview pack with all generated questions.

resources.name: my-shortlists
resources.description: For the calling user, the roles where you have approvals to make.

prompts.name: prepare-interview-brief
prompts.description: Assemble everything an interviewer needs to walk into a conversation with a specific candidate against a specific role: CV summary, dimension scores with reasoning, the generated interview pack, and any prior notes or transcript analyses.

prompts.name: weekly-shortlist-review
prompts.description: For a hiring manager, summarise the current state of approvals on a role and surface the top candidates still awaiting a decision.

prompts.name: email-candidate-introduction
prompts.description: Draft an introduction email to a third party (typically a hiring manager) about a specific candidate against a specific role. Pulls the CV summary and score so the narrative is grounded in actual SkillAi data.
